comment: Persistent local knowledge base of the audit skills (user requirement 2026-07-16): stable facts are recorded HERE once and reused by every run instead of being re-mined or re-asked. The orchestrator MUST read this file at interview start, prefill run-config from it, ask the user ONLY about missing/new facts, and APPEND newly confirmed facts after each run. Past periods never change — only extend.
